_comment: SavedPaymentMethod record that the Billing 'Create Billing Promise to Pay' flow (billing__CreateBillingPromisetoPay) lists in its Saved Payment Method grid. Required in testing: Name, MerchantAccountId, ReferenceOwnerId, PaymentGatewayId, Status, UsageType, Type, GatewayReference. A CardPaymentMethod created by the tokenize API alone is NOT listed by the flow.
